verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document a built-in AI assistant to which users can delegate tasks. The only possible hint is the bare pricing-page label "Ask Fellow", which has no description of what it does. Fellow's MCP server lets external assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) read meeting data, which is an integration for third-party agents, not an in-product assistant. Automatic AI summaries and action items are passive generation features, not task delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
